column8: The compound ຜົນງານ (works/achievements) is split into ຜົນ (fruit) and ງານ (work/festival), each a common word, blurring the intended single noun.

column5: ຈົນກວ່າພັນ
column6: ປີນັ້ນລ່ວງໄປແລ້ວ
column8: The number-unit pair ພັນປີ (thousand years) in the Revelation 20:5 quotation is split between the number and its unit.

column5: ຊາວໂລກ ແລະ ຊາວ
column6: ສະຫວັນ
column8: The compound ຊາວສະຫວັນ (inhabitants of heaven) is split so the line ends on ຊາວ, which alone can read as the number twenty.

column5: ມະນຸດ ແລະ ຊາວ
column6: ສະຫວັນຈະຜູກພັນກັນ
column8: The compound ຊາວສະຫວັນ (heaven-dwellers) is split after ຊາວ, which alone can read as the number twenty.

column5: ອັນຕະຫຼອດໄປເປັນ
column6: ນິດ
column8: The fixed phrase ຕະຫຼອດໄປເປັນນິດ (forever) is broken so the syllable ນິດ (a tiny bit) stands alone at the line start.

column5: ຊົງໄຖ່ຕະຫຼອດໄປເປັນ
column6: ນິດ
column8: The fixed phrase ຕະຫຼອດໄປເປັນນິດ (forever) is broken so the syllable ນິດ stands alone at the line start.

column5: ຍຸຕິທຳ ແລະ ທ່ຽງ
column6: ແທ້
column8: The compound adjective ທ່ຽງແທ້ (true/just) in the quoted verse is split into ທ່ຽງ (noon/exact) and ແທ້ (truly), each reading as a different word.

column5: ໃໝ່ໆ, ຂໍ້
column6: ເທັດຈິງໃໝ່ໆ
column7: ຂໍ້ເທັດຈິງ
column8: The compound ຂໍ້ເທັດຈິງ (fact) is split after the prefix ຂໍ້, so the next line opens with ເທັດ (false), inviting a momentary opposite reading.

column5: ຕະຫຼອດຊົ່ວ
column6: ນິຣັນດອນ
column7: ຊົ່ວນິຣັນດອນ
column8: The phrase ຕະຫຼອດຊົ່ວນິຣັນດອນ (for all eternity) is split so the line ends on ຊົ່ວ, which alone reads as "evil" in a doxology.
